rĕgĭōnālis , e, adj. regio,
I.of or belonging to a province or region: concilium, provincial (opp. plenarium), Aug. Bapt. contr. Donat. 7, 53. — Adv.: rĕgĭōnālĭ-ter , by provinces or regions, = regionatim, App. de Mundo, 23, p. 68, 2; Cael. Aur. Acut. 2, 29, 157.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
